description: GOB account data handed over by the enforcement workflow after GOB accepted an Enforcement case's hearing results (feature 002). The consumer (service-cp-crime-results-enforcementworkflow) keeps a verbatim copy of this schema.

correlationId.description: Share correlation id: UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(hearingId + "|" + hearingDay); must match hearingId and hearingDay

sharedTime.description: When the results handed over were shared; a later hand-over for the same correlation id replaces an earlier one

gobDataReused.description: true when GOB was not called for this share (amend & reshare, or nothing new) and these are the most recent GOB data already received

coveredResultDefinitionIds.description: Result definition ids the GOB data covers (checked for amended NOWS)
